reason: Selected CAE ablations separate domain information from added reflection, with strong limitations from model and benchmark comparisons.

candidates.title: Test direct domain tutorials before building a specialized scaffold
candidates.rule: For simulation agents lacking solver-specific idioms, compare direct relevant tutorials with optional or absent tutorials before investing in additional retrieval orchestration.
candidates.finding: Forced tutorial reading improves FoamBench from 80.9% to 96.4%, gives a smaller gain on SimBench and no gain on already-saturated MCP-SIM. The benefit depends on the solver and missing knowledge.
models: Direct Baseline commercial harness/backbone setting; exact ablation model not established in inspected sections
candidates.conditions: Information access and repair budgets are controlled in tutorial ablations; a shared engineered prompt is already present.
candidates.limitations: Single runs, small non-FoamBench suites and benchmark-native success criteria. Execution may not establish physical correctness. Published specialized-agent comparisons use different backbones, so they do not isolate the value of removing scaffolding.
candidates.validation_test: Compare absent, optional and directly supplied tutorials under one model and repair budget; validate numerical/physical correctness and measure tutorial cost on genuinely unfamiliar solver tasks.

candidates.title: Measure the marginal value of scripted reflection
candidates.rule: When a coding harness already supplies execution feedback and repair attempts, compare an added self-reflection instruction with the unchanged harness before retaining it.
candidates.passage: Both configurations land at the same success rate
candidates.finding: On FoamBench, Direct Baseline and added scripted reflection both solve 106 of 110 cases. The tested instruction has no observed marginal success benefit in this setting.
models: Direct Baseline ablation backbone not established in inspected sections
candidates.conditions: Same harness, repair budget and scoring; instruction asks reflection on case files and solver script before execution.
candidates.limitations: Single-run null result cannot establish equivalence or prove native reflection is the mechanism. Scope is one benchmark and one added instruction, not all reflection methods.
candidates.validation_test: Compare with and without the instruction over repeated runs using identical execution feedback and repair budgets; report success, numerical correctness, latency and tokens.

review_scope: Selected abstract, introduction, methods or main-result sections; not a comprehensive paper or appendix review.
